content.text: Frequently Asked QuestionsWhat is Fubo?Fubo is a service that broadcasts live TV over the internet, no cable required. Watch your favorite teams, network shows, news and movies on 200+ channels. Plus on-demand entertainment including full TV series.Can I watch soccer leagues live with Fubo?Yes! Fubo networks broadcast Champions League, MLS, Ligue 1, Liga MX and many other leagues and tournaments.How can I watch the NFL online without cable?To watch the NFL without cable, just start a free trial of Fubo. You can start watching immediately on your TV, phone, computer and more. There's no contract.Does Fubo have channels like ABC, CBS and FOX?Yes, Fubo has ABC*, CBS* and FOX* as well as ESPN, MTV, VH1, SHOWTIME, FX, Comedy Central and Disney Channel among others. *Regional restrictions apply.Are leagues like the NFL, NBA, MLB and others available?Absolutely! Not only does Fubo have the NFL, NBA and MLB, but you can also watch NHL, NASCAR, MLS, golf, tennis, boxing, MMA, college sports and more. Plus, we have every golf major, tennis major and Triple Crown race as well as full coverage of specials like the Super Bowl, World Series, NBA Finals, Stanley Cup Playoffs and Olympics.Is Fubo available where I live?Fubo is currently available in the United States, Canada and Spain. Packages and pricing differ per country.How much does Fubo cost?Prices vary based on your plan, region and selected add-ons. Our most popular plan in the United States includes 200+ channels of live sports and TV for half the cost of the average monthly cable bill.Can I watch ESPN Unlimited with Fubo?If your Fubo base plan includes the ESPN channel then ESPN Unlimited is now included at no extra cost. Just activate ESPN Unlimited through your Fubo account or invitation email and start streaming via the ESPN app or website.How do I activate ESPN Unlimited from my email?Fubo subscribers on eligible plans will get an email invite, which will include an "Activate Now" link, and instructions on how to or sign into a MyDisney account. That’s it — you’re set to watch ESPN Unlimited.How do I activate ESPN Unlimited from the Fubo website?Log in at fubo.tv and click on the Settings gear. Click My Account and then Subscription. If you're on an eligible plan, you’ll see the option to activate ESPN Unlimited. Just follow the prompts to set up your MyDisney account and unlock ESPN Unlimited access instantly.Do I have to sign a contract?No. Fubo is strictly on a month-to-month or quarterly basis. Your subscription will automatically renew until you choose to cancel your account in your profile.What if I want to cancel?We’d hate to see you go, but we understand. That's why we've made it easy. Cancel online anytime without paying fees.What devices can I watch Fubo on?You can watch Fubo on your computer, iPhone, iPad, Android phone and tablet, Roku, Apple TV, Chromecast, Xbox consoles and Amazon Fire TV.What channel is the NBA game today?NBA games today air on national networks like ESPN, ABC, and NBA TV as well as regional sports channels such as FanDuel Sports Network. If you're looking for the Charlotte Hornets game today, check your local listings to confirm the channel in your area. You can stream these networks live on Fubo and stay updated on the Hornets score, match stats, and player performances throughout the game.How to watch Hornets live stream?To watch a Hornets live stream without cable, sign up for Fubo and stream games airing on FanDuel Sports Network, or ESPN, ABC, and NBA TV. Once streaming, you can follow the Hornets score live, analyze match stats, and watch every player matchup in HD. Many fans also check the Hornets starting lineup before tipoff. Hornets games are available based on your location and broadcast rights, so confirm coverage in your region before streaming.Does Fubo have Charlotte Hornets games?Yes, Fubo carries channels that broadcast Charlotte Hornets games, including FanDuel Sports Network, or ESPN, ABC, and NBA TV. Availability of regional sports networks and local channels depends on your location and may be subject to blackout restrictions. Hornets games are available based on your region and NBA broadcast rights.Can I watch Charlotte Hornets games without cable?Yes, you can watch Charlotte Hornets games without cable by streaming channels like ESPN, ABC, and NBA TV on Fubo. Hornets games are available based on your location and national broadcast rights. With live streaming, you can follow the Hornets score in real time, review match stats, and watch every player throughout the season. Be sure to check the Hornets starting lineup before tipoff and confirm regional availability to avoid blackout restrictions.How can I watch Hornets games online free?You can watch Hornets games online by signing up for a streaming service that carries FanDuel Sports Network, or ESPN, ABC, and NBA TV and national NBA channels. Fubo offers a free trial for eligible new subscribers, allowing you to stream live Hornets games without cable. During the game, you can track the Hornets score, view match stats, and follow each player's performance from any supported device. Hornets games are available depending on your location and broadcast rights, so check availability before streaming.Still have questions? Expert help, just a click away.For technical questions or getting help with your account, visit our Help Centerto find more answers and contact us.Agent hours of availability: 10:00 AM - 10:00PM ET - 7 days a week.
